title: The Antler Crown
text: A crown of antlers hangs on a branch over the path, bound with red thread and old hair. Its points are stained dark. As you look at it, the whole wood falls silent: no birds, no wind, every leaf holding still to see what you will do.

options.label: The boldest among you snatches the crown without a second thought and sets it upon their head.

outcomes.text: The wood bows to them, every branch at once, and the silence becomes something like welcome.
The wood does not bow. It comes for the one who would usurp it.

options.label: Leave it hanging. Its place is in the wild, not in the hands of men.

outcomes.text: The birds start singing again, and the wood lets you through as a friend. Nothing stalks you that night, and you sleep.

options.label: Plunder the crown, so that it may bring glory to your House.

outcomes.text: It fetches a fine price in town, and thorns find every step of the way out of the wood.
